description: Quick general-knowledge questions from science, history, geography and more.

questions.prompt: What is the numeric value of the Roman numeral L?
questions.fact: No wonder turning 50 feels like taking a massive L!

questions.prompt: On the periodic table, which element is represented by the letter P?
How many rings are there in Olympics Logo?
questions.fact: The Olympic logo has 5 rings, representing the five continents of the world. And Audi has 4 rings in its logo.

questions.prompt: Which of these birds can fly?
questions.fact: Among the listed birds, only the eagle can fly. Penguins, chickens, and ostriches are flightless birds.

questions.prompt: Where is Leaning Tower of Pisa located?
questions.fact: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is located in Pisa, Italy.

questions.prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.fact: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.

questions.prompt: Which of these elements is NOT one of the 4 elements?
questions.fact: The classical four elements are Earth, Air, Fire, and Water. 'Sea' is not one of them.

questions.prompt: How many colors are there in a rainbow?
questions.fact: A rainbow has 7 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.

questions.prompt: Which of these takes longer to happen in real time?
options: The Earth making one complete trip around the Sun
The Moon going through all of its phases (New Moon to New Moon)
Pluto finishing a single orbit around the Sun
Earth spinning around on its axis one time
questions.fact: A single "Pluto year" takes **248 Earth years**, making it vastly longer than a standard Earth year, moon cycle, or single day!

questions.prompt: If you weigh 100 kgs on Earth, how much would you weigh right at the exact center of the Earth?
questions.fact: At the exact center of the Earth, gravity cancels out, making you effectively weightless.
